Charger feetPaintRadius 0.7 is a local footprint calibration for guaranteed feet paint; physical Switch radius remains unverified.

#539 Charger partial-charge movement: partialChargeMoveStart 5.76 (S3 0.96 normal-side) and partialChargeMoveEnd 1.26 (S3 0.21 maximum-partial side) are community verification-table values (wikiwiki Splat Charger table, not re-fetched: HTTP 403), NOT in the pinned Leanny WeaponChargerNormal extraction, which carries only MoveSpeedFullCharge 0.02 (1.2 u/s); the linear interior between start and end and its Nintendo easing are unverified; the 1.2 full-charge endpoint remains the pinned value
Death-cause respawn totals 8.5/7.0/5.5s are public-reference values retained from PR #186; official 11.3.0 parameter confirmation remains unavailable.

Roller roll-stop action interruption (main 16F / sub 5F / squid 6F) is a community frame measurement from the S3 verification table '検証/メインウェポン/前隙・後隙', 塗り進み interruption row. The page returned HTTP 403 on the 2026-10-06 re-fetch, so the three numbers are recorded with that source and NOT claimed as re-verified here; the frame-to-second conversion is /60 and the endpoint convention is 'roll-end tick is frame 0'. They are not pinned Ver. 11.3.0 parameter-table fields.

Rescued from PR #63: shooter fire gates, charger air/empty/min-release/store timing, HP regen rates and death-cause respawn routing remain regression-backed; physical-device confirmation is still pending.

weapons.charger.reticleDelayF (5F charge-reticle display delay, S3 main-weapon verification table) is a published community measurement, not an extracted 11.3.0 game parameter and not confirmed by a new Switch capture; per-variant gauge delays (Goo Tuber, Grizzco) are not implemented

Roller rollContactInterval uses the S3 community v10.0.0 repeated-contact table 24F (0.4s). Normal BodyParam default is corroborated by the published parameter table; no direct v11.3.0 console measurement is claimed. Boss uses the same INKWAVE weapon interval, not Salmon Run Coop timing.

weapons.splatling.chargeJumpVelocity (4.2 world u/s) is the existing DU/f x6 calibration applied to the S3 gear-power verification table's 0.7 DU/f charging jump initial velocity for non-exception splatlings (Heavy Splatling). It is the same calibration already used for weapons.charger.fullChargeJumpVelocity (pinned JumpHeightFullCharge 0.07 x60 = 4.2) and for enemyInkJumpVel (pinned OpInk_JumpVel 0.08 x60 = 4.8). The pinned 11.3.0 WeaponSpinnerStandard WeaponParam exposes JumpGnd_Charge 0.08 but no field named like the charger's JumpHeightFullCharge; it is not treated as this value. Splat Spinner / Ballpoint / Heavy Edit / R-PEN/5H exceptions (1.0 DU/f) are not implemented because those weapons are absent; the field is per-weapon so they can be added as data. No direct Switch capture was taken.
